title: Carnitas Burrito Recipe – Easy, Flavorful Mexican Pulled Pork Wrap
ldIngredientsRaw: 2 cups hot carnitas ((Dutch oven, Coca-Cola, or condensed milk version))
1 cup shredded cheese ((cheddar, Oaxaca, or queso fresco) – optional)
ldInstructionsRaw: Heat each tortilla on a griddle or comal until soft and pliable, about 30 seconds.

Spread about ⅓ cup of refried beans across the center of the tortilla, leaving space at the edges. Top with about ½ cup of hot carnitas, a sprinkle of cheese, a spoonful of salsa, and a dollop of guacamole.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll it up tightly from the bottom to seal.
Place seam-side down on a hot griddle to seal and crisp the burrito. Flip once golden, about 1–2 minutes per side.
Place burrito on parchment paper, then wrap in foil for a road-ready meal.
